name: Beijing Ultrapower Software Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Ultrapower Software Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides software and information technology services in China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: AI-Cloud Services, Gaming, IoT Communications, and Innovative Business. It offers ICT operations management solutions, including AI native, AI + digital transformation, AI + self-intelligent network, and AI + converged communications; information security, such as safe operations, identity security, asset security, and safety management; system integration; mobile internet operation; artificial intelligence; and cloud services.
